figures.finding: Work by children and adolescents under fourteen is forbidden save artistic and cultural activities authorised by the competent body for the protection of children and adolescents; from fourteen to eighteen the work follows the Constitution and the LOPNNA, whose hours and registration rules weren't read.

value.permit: authorisation of the órgano competente para la protección de niños, niñas y adolescentes (LOTTT art. 32)

figures.applies: The exception is for 'artistic and cultural activities', which reaches a child's acting and, by its words, a child's creative work generally; the LOPNNA's rules are a blocker. Read from FAOLEX's scan of the Gaceta, whose text layer misreads some letters ('cuarido' for 'cuando'), so it is marked secondary.

sources.said: Se prohíbe el trabajo de niños, niñas y adolescentes, que no hayan cumplido catorce años de edad, … actividades artísticas y culturales y hayan sido autorizados por el órgano competente para la protección de niños, niñas y adolescentes.

sources.title: FAOLEX: Gaceta Oficial Nº 6.076 Extraordinario (7 May 2012), Decreto 8.938, LOTTT art. 32
